name: Process Flow
tagline: A choice column as a Business Process Flow stage bar.

presets.name: Sales stages
presets.description: The familiar flow: two stages behind, one in progress, one ahead. Click a stage to move the record.

presets.name: Colours from the options
presets.description: Each stage drawn in its own choice colour. The tick flips between black and white so it stays readable on any of them.

presets.name: Steps marked out of sequence
presets.description: A Multi-Select Choice column, so the marks are explicit rather than implied. The last marked stage in option order is the current one.

presets.name: Hidden steps
presets.description: Cancelled and On hold are named in the exclude list, so they never appear — and a record holding one keeps it. Clear the exclude box to see them.

presets.name: A plain Choice column
presets.description: One stored value, so the stages before it read as completed — the way a native process flow does. Clicking a stage moves the record rather than adding to it.

presets.name: Nothing reached yet
presets.description: An empty column. Every stage is ahead of the record, and the bar says so rather than looking broken.
